text:
Maya (CEO): posting a short follow-up for the "wins & losses" segment from today9 if you missed it, drop questions here and we9ll capture actions
Liam (Head of Sales): field summary: several deals closed after we provided scoped eval help; a couple lost to low-cost self-host quantized options
Elena (Customer Success): confirmation: assisted evals (scoring + sanitization) closed 3 pilots last quarter. customers repeatedly said that was the deciding factor
Sam P. (VP Product): product question: do we want a public "what we guarantee" doc vs a sales-facing addendum?
Anya (PM): proposal: public latency profile explainer + gated Sales playbook that includes add-on services and sample configs
Rohit (Solutions Eng): demo note: we often fix demo regressions by pinning model variants and pre-warming KV caches. can we expose simple presets in Dedicated?
Maya (CEO): yes9 preset idea: "balanced / latency-first / cost-first". surface tradeoffs clearly in the UI and playbook
Liam (Head of Sales): Sales asks: standardize a small paid "eval engagement" (e.g., fixed hours + one report). vagueness kills deals
LegalBot: recommend a template: 12 eng hours, one integration call, deliverable = evaluation report. Legal will draft contract language once pricing is set
Elena (Customer Success): also request a short eval checklist for Sales: data hygiene, PII redaction, sample prompts to run, success criteria
Anya (PM): actionables I captured: 1) latency explainer doc (public); 2) Starter Dedicated quickstart (sales-facing); 3) eval engagement template + checklist; 4) Sales cheat-sheet slide
Sam P. (VP Product): small roadmap tweak: bump pre-warm/pinning UX + add a Console card for "output stability" (prompt drift, token length, recent regressions)
Rohit (Solutions Eng): include a troubleshooting appendix for tokenization/encoding gotchas. small snippet we use in support: 
```
# tokenization sanity check
tok_count = tokenizer.encode(prompt)
if tok_count > expected: log_warning()
```
DeployBot: docs/plays/starter-dedicated-quickstart.md created by Anya at 2225004255 :white_check_mark:
Liam (Head of Sales): I'll DM anonymized RFP snippets that referenced price or evals to help price the starter package
Maya (CEO): can we get draft slide + playbook + sample contract addendum by next Tue?
Anya (PM): yes. I'll post drafts by Mon EOD and update this thread with links. assigning Sam to review latency doc and Legal to draft addendum
Elena (Customer Success): CS will pilot the eval engagement offering with two customers this quarter and feed pricing back to Sales/Product
Maya (CEO): perfect. thanks all 9 tag Anya for follow-ups. we'll review progress in next leadership sync :sparkles:
